name: pttag-integrity-from-source-declaration
description: The trifecta's leg A. A tag's untrusted-origin mark comes from the tool's own SEP-1913 returnMetadata.source declaration, and this run mints two tags from two tools that are identical in every other respect — same permission, same effects, same declared read of the same resource — differing only in that one declares source: untrustedPublic. Exactly one of the two tags carries an untrusted origin. The pair is the point: a run whose reads all answer the same way passes whether the declaration is consulted or hardcoded, so the SPLIT is what proves the signal is read. Nothing set UntrustedOrigin before this, so leg A was structurally false for every tag ever minted and the trifecta could not fire however dangerous the delegation.
